summary: prefill-activations a4 switches the hybrid A4 prefill with B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL on images whose vLLM picks the prefill rows itself
compatibility: On those images B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS is no longer read; the launcher refuses it and names B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL. Older images keep the threshold.
details: a4 sets B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL=1 and a16 sets 0; an explicit B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL decides the option.
vLLM runs every prefill row with NVFP4 activations, short and chunked prefills included; decode and verification rows, CUDA graph replays, draft and profiling forwards keep W4A16.
